description: Create a comprehensive 90-day content calendar with blog post drafts targeting specific keywords

clientName.label: Client Name
clientName.description: Client name for context and personalization

collectionName.label: Target CMS Collection
collectionName.description: The Webflow CMS collection where blog post drafts will be created

targetKeywords.label: Target Keywords or Themes
targetKeywords.placeholder: e.g., web design trends, responsive design, UX best practices, Webflow tutorials, design systems
targetKeywords.default: web design trends, responsive design, UX best practices, Webflow tutorials, design systems, accessibility standards
targetKeywords.description: Comma-separated list of target keywords or content themes to focus on throughout the 90-day calendar

industryContext.label: Industry Context or Goals (Optional)
industryContext.placeholder: e.g., B2B SaaS company focused on design teams. Goal: establish thought leadership, drive demo signups. Target audience: product designers and design managers.
industryContext.description: Additional context about industry, business goals, target audience, or content objectives

postsPerWeek.label: Posts Per Week (Optional)
postsPerWeek.description: Desired number of blog posts per week. Default is 2 (approximately 26 posts over 90 days).
